newsitem.title: MEXICO: Foreign direct investment in Mexico rises - Secofi.
newsitem.headline: Foreign direct investment in Mexico rises - Secofi.

text.p: Foreign direct investment in Mexico rose 21.8 percent to $1.009 billion in the first four months of this year compared to the same period a year ago, the Trade Ministry (Secofi) said on Thursday.
"The estimate of direct foreign investment in the first four months of 1997 registered an increase of 21.8 percent compared to the year before, rising to $1.0086 billion," Secofi said in a statement.

Of that total, $309.9 million was noted in the National Register of Foreign Investments (RNIE), $406.8 million was the import of fixed assets by the maquiladora industry, and $536.8 million was in the reinvestment of profits.
On the negative side, there was $244.9 million in internal company accounts, the ministry said.
Secofi said that it expects direct foreign investment to reach at least the 1996 level of $9 billion.
